successCriteria.text: 100% of records from declared healthy inventory sources are represented or explicitly listed as unmatched, excluded, or failed-to-ingest; no discovered item disappears silently.
successCriteria.measure: 5/5 declared sources represented or listed as gaps

successCriteria.text: At least 99% of observed source-state changes appear with provenance in the current-state view within 2 minutes while the source is healthy.
successCriteria.measure: state changes re-observed after 120000ms (<=120000ms) with durable checkpoint

successCriteria.text: Machine-wide discovery identifies 100% of seeded supported source instances and at least 95% of seeded previously unregistered source candidates within the declared, authorized boundary.
100% of discovered unsupported, inaccessible, sensitive, unowned, excluded, moved, or disappeared sources remain visible with current coverage state, reason, stewardship action, and history.
In all least-privilege discovery tests, the platform catalogs available source metadata without reading protected content, secrets, or credentials beyond the discovery principal's current authority.
successCriteria.measure: out-of-scope target never probed=true; all evidence metadata-only=true

lines.assertionText: Given healthy connected sources contain AI assets and governance records, When the officer opens the current-state view, Then each item appears once with its type, source identity, owner, lifecycle state, risk, control coverage, evidence state, health, last observation time, and unresolved issues.

evidence.detail: each healthy registered source appears exactly once (uniqueness=true) with scope/onboarding/observedAt authoritative fields
durable discovery evidence recorded for each healthy source (evidence state)

lines.assertionText: Given a component is discovered but unmanaged, unreachable, stale, orphaned, or explicitly excluded, When inventory is reconciled, Then it remains visible as a coverage gap with reason, age, impact, and required owner action rather than appearing healthy or disappearing.

evidence.detail: discovered-but-unmanaged/unreachable/excluded persist as reasoned gaps (never healthy, never absent)

lines.assertionText: Given related work exists across registered sources, including Kanban, agentctl, and workflows_orchestration, When the officer drills into an item, Then the view shows their distinct source records, correlation, status differences, dependencies, and authoritative fields.

evidence.detail: three DISTINCT source records preserved across 3 systems (no collapse/merge of distinct sources)
per-source discovery evidence keeps each record independently traceable (correlation preserves distinct records)

lines.assertionText: Given a source becomes stale or unavailable, When the view is refreshed, Then affected data is visibly marked with its last-known time and confidence, and current compliance or health is not inferred from stale data.

evidence.detail: stale/disappeared source retains its last-known observation (last-known time=1700000000000); health not inferred from stale data
durable checkpoint distinguishes the refreshed sweep clock from the stale source last-known time

lines.assertionText: Given an unregistered governance-relevant source appears within the declared computer boundary, When discovery runs, Then it is added to the source catalog with discovery evidence, type or unknown classification, location, access status, sensitivity, ownership status, and onboarding state.

evidence.detail: previously-unregistered in-boundary source added to catalog with classification/location/onboarding/access state
durable discovery-evidence record proves the source was discovered (not assumed)

lines.assertionText: Given a discovered source is unsupported, inaccessible, sensitive, unowned, or intentionally excluded, When coverage is assessed, Then it remains visible as a governed source gap with reason, impact, owner action, and review or expiry.

evidence.detail: excluded (out-of-scope) + inaccessible (probe-failed) discovered sources remain governed gaps with reason + owner action + reviewability

frClauses.clause: MUST maintain an explicit, versioned deployment and inventory boundary … including authorized scope and exclusions for machine-wide source discovery.
witness: exclusion enforced: secretstore:vault-1 scope=secretstore → gapReason=out_of_scope (out-of-authorized-scope, never scanned)

frClauses.clause: MUST discover and continuously reconcile … within that boundary; discovery MUST NOT depend on a fixed list of named source products.
witness: two sweeps reconciled the same catalog (each targetId once): total=8
open-ended: an UNKNOWN-scope source (unknown:svc-new) was discovered without a named-product list → onboarding=discovered

frClauses.clause: MUST provide a unified current-state view that preserves each item’s source identity, type, ownership, lifecycle state, … last observation time.
MUST expose provenance, source authority, freshness, confidence, and any disagreement for correlated data.
witness: provenance: every durable record carries a correlationId (15 records, all stamped)
freshness: stale source kanban:board-stale retains lastKnownAt=1700000000000 < refresh clock=1700000120000
checkpoint distinguishes fresh sweep clock=1700000120000 from stale last-known

frClauses.clause: MUST show discovered, unmanaged, unreachable, stale, orphaned, excluded, and uncovered items as explicit gaps with impact, age, reason, and ownership.
MUST present pending human decisions prioritized by business impact, risk, age, expiry, dependency, and escalation status.
witness: pending-decision set this view produces (discovered-awaiting-onboarding + visible gaps), oldest-first by age:
frClauses.coveredElsewhere: business-impact/risk/expiry/dependency/escalation ordering is the decision-queue view (US-decision-queue); this discovery emitter durably supplies the age-ordered pending set + reason it prioritizes on.

frClauses.clause: Authorized users MUST be able to search, filter, compare, and drill from an aggregate posture into the source records, evidence, decisions, and issues that explain it.
witness: filter substrate: catalog.sources()=5, catalog.gaps()=3 are independently queryable projections
drill substrate: aggregate posture (total=8) drills to distinct source records kanban:board-42:kanban, agentctl:agent-7:agentctl, workflows_orchestration:wf-9:workflows_orchestration
compare substrate: three distinct scopes preserved for the same drill = 3 distinct records
frClauses.coveredElsewhere: the interactive search/filter/compare UI is the current-state view surface; this emitter durably supplies the queryable, drillable catalog+evidence substrate it reads.

frClauses.clause: MUST correlate work moving through all registered sources … keeping distinct source records.
Conflicting or uncertain correlations MUST remain visible and MUST NOT be silently resolved.
witness: distinct sources are NEVER silently merged: 3/3 remain separate catalog rows
indeterminate authorization would surface as a visible gap (authorization_indeterminate) rather than a silent choice — reason vocabulary present in GAP_REASONS

frClauses.clause: Every discovered source MUST have a catalog entry containing stable identity … lifecycle state, and observation time.
Discovery MUST use the least information necessary … MUST NOT read protected content, secrets, or credentials … and MUST record any resulting visibility limitation.
witness: least-privilege: out-of-scope target secretstore:vault-1 was NEVER probed (probeCalls excludes it=true)
every durable payload is metadata-only (shape tag, never verbatim content): 15 records
visibility limitation recorded: secretstore:vault-1 → gap reason out_of_scope

frClauses.clause: Authorized source stewards MUST be able to approve onboarding, assign ownership, … quarantine, defer, or exclude a discovered source with a mandatory reason, scope, review date, and audit trail.
witness: audit-trail substrate: durable checkpoints=3, each carrying a safeNextAction (none) — the attributable, reasoned trail steward actions append to
every discovery record is correlationId-stamped (reason/scope carried at write time): 15 records
the discovered set awaiting a steward onboarding decision: unknown:svc-new
frClauses.coveredElsewhere: steward mutation actions (approve/quarantine/defer/exclude with mandatory reason+scope+review-date) are the governed-decision surface (FR-010/FR-011/FR-014); this emitter durably supplies the auditable trail + the discovered set those actions operate on.

frClauses.clause: Unsupported, inaccessible, sensitive, unowned, and excluded sources MUST remain visible as source-coverage gaps with impact and requirements for safe onboarding or review.
MUST detect newly appearing, changed, renamed, moved, replaced, split, merged, and disappeared sources while retaining their prior identity, history, correlations, and evidence.
witness: newly appearing: unknown:svc-new discovered on sweep 1 (onboarding=discovered)
disappeared: kanban:board-stale dropped from sweep 2 yet its prior identity+last-known observation PERSIST (lastKnownAt=1700000000000, still in catalog=true)
history retained: append-only evidence sink keeps 15 records across both sweeps (reconstructable history)
frClauses.coveredElsewhere: renamed/moved/replaced/split/merged transitions are exercised by the identity-continuity suite; this emitter witnesses the appear + disappear-with-retained-identity edges and the append-only history substrate all of them rely on.

frClauses.clause: When multiple sources claim authority for the same field or object, the platform MUST apply an approved precedence rule or expose the unresolved conflict; it MUST NOT silently choose a source.
witness: no silent source choice: the three same-work sources kanban:board-42, agentctl:agent-7, workflows_orchestration:wf-9 are kept as 3 DISTINCT rows (never collapsed to one)
frClauses.coveredElsewhere: the approved precedence-rule engine / conflict-resolution UI is the correlation surface (FR-004 disagreement); this emitter guarantees the no-silent-choice invariant by keeping conflicting sources as distinct, individually visible records.
